name: Outlines
author: dottxt-ai
one_liner: Forces a model's output to match a type, regex, choice list or grammar, so the structure is valid by construction.

loop.proposes: the next token of text from a local or hosted model
loop.judged_by: a finite-state or grammar automaton built from the requested type, regex or grammar
loop.steers: tokens that would break the pattern are ruled out, so only valid continuations can be chosen

not_proved: It guarantees the shape of the output (valid JSON, a regex match, one of the listed choices), not that the values inside are true or sensible.
